title: Kossuth Lajos és a független politikai sajtó (Lajos Kossuth's Rise)
grammar: Evidential & Modal Particles in Reformist Discourse

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can tell how Lajos Kossuth reached the public with the press and with speeches.
I can use elengedhetetlen, hogy ... to say what a reform needed.
I can say what Kossuth demanded for the nobles and for the serfs.
I can use eight new words about the press and reform demands.
